Keep clear areas away from seals and do not infer whole-pack barrier from the printed part of the pouch. Aluminum reference: foil or coating? The material information mentions aluminum. Confirm whether it means continuous foil, a metalized film or a list of alternative materials; these are not interchangeable specifications.
